criteria.ownership: Offers/gates stay separate from action-feel, wallet ledger, entitlement and restore owners.
criteria.evidence: Configured/test purchase evidence is not promoted to conversion or revenue proof.
criteria.compliance: Price/region/platform requirements are verified for shipping rather than guessed.
